references.phrase: quotient topology induced by surjection X→f(X)
references.context: Topology: final quotient topology associated with a surjection onto its set-theoretic image

references.disposition: Equality is required on the image, not on all of Y; the map need not be surjective onto Y.

review_rationale: Read the strict-map comparison of two topologies on the image f(X): quotient topology induced by X and subspace topology induced by Y. This need not require f to be globally surjective onto Y.
